subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming stay as Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a native preset gallery and custom theme studio with OpenClaw-owned persistence?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower external-editor import model, while this issue asks for new native UI, setting, i18n, and persistence surfaces that need product/design ownership before implementation.

options.title: Define a native theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, override, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Document the existing tweakcn import slot as the supported customization path and close or narrow the native studio request after preserving the external editor alternative.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, synced persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing as separately approved slices instead of one broad feature.

recommendation.title: Define a native theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, override, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the issue and authored the current custom-theme import path, making them the best available owner for the theming product choice.
